title: The Choir Before the Army
reflectionQuestion: Have you ever had to face something too big for you — and found that showing up was enough?
reflectionText: There is a kind of courage that does not look like courage. It looks like singing. The army of Judah went out to face a force they could not defeat, and instead of weapons they sent the choir — before the battle, while the outcome was still unknown. What is it to admit you have no plan, in front of your people, and still walk into the morning?
